link.description: URL of the listing's own detail page, if one was found.

deadline.description: Application deadline as stated on the listing, or 'Not specified'.

eligibility.description: The listing's own stated eligibility text, as scraped.

hardRequirementsMet.description: Whether deadline, nationality, and education level (checked with plain code, not an LLM) all pass.

eligibilityConfidence.description: Verified (the listing's own eligibility text was actually checked) or Unverified (verdict rests on hard requirements alone).

missingRequirements.description: Specific requirements the profile does not meet, when eligibilityMatch is Partial or Not Eligible.

llmInterpretation.description: Plain-language reasoning when an LLM had to resolve genuinely ambiguous eligibility wording.

actionSteps.description: What to actually do next for this listing, when applicable.

usedCvEvidence.description: Whether the student's uploaded/pasted CV was used to resolve an otherwise-ambiguous requirement.

trustRisk.description: Low Risk, Some Concerns, or High Risk.

trustScore.description: Underlying weighted score trustRisk is derived from.

trustEvidence.description: The specific signals behind the trust score, e.g. 'No risk signals detected' or 'Independent evidence was found'.

trustConfidence.description: How much independent evidence actually backs the trust score: Very low, Low, Medium, or High.

urgency.description: Closing soon, Upcoming, Plenty of time, Closed, or Unknown, derived from deadline.

daysRemaining.description: Days until the deadline, or null if the deadline is unknown/unparseable.

source.description: Which scholarship-portal source this listing was scraped from.

scrapedFor.description: The student profile this listing was matched and trust-scored against.

results.title: Matched opportunities
results.description: One row per listing, with eligibility and trust verdicts side by side.
